subject.title: build(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 3 updates

question: After the current-head `macos-swift` validation completes, should the macOS owner accept this grouped Swift package update for Sparkle, SwiftLog, and swift-concurrency-extras?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it intentionally advances three native dependencies, including the macOS updater framework; compatibility acceptance is an owner judgment rather than an automated code repair.

options.title: Validate and accept
options.body: Require successful current-head native macOS validation, then accept the upstream package revisions if the owner is comfortable with their release notes and upgrade exposure.

options.title: Split or defer the group
options.body: Defer the grouped update or ask Dependabot to regenerate a narrower PR if one dependency needs independent compatibility review.

recommendation.title: Validate and accept
recommendation.body: Require successful current-head native macOS validation, then accept the upstream package revisions if the owner is comfortable with their release notes and upgrade exposure.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline routes this macOS package update to steipete, making them the strongest available decision candidate.
